Subject: Formal Warning Regarding Conduct at Office Party

Dear Janet,

I am writing to formally address your recent conduct at the office party. Your behavior was not only embarrassing but also highly inappropriate. Specifically, dancing on tables and shouting profanities is not the behavior we expect from our staff.

Please consider this a formal warning. Such actions will not be tolerated again. We expect all employees to maintain professional standards at all company events.

Regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
